allowed_edit_targets.name: controller_weights
allowed_edit_targets.principle: bounded verifier-feedback controllers may update inspectable weights

allowed_edit_targets.name: trace_memory
allowed_edit_targets.principle: source-traced memories may be added only with replay evidence

allowed_edit_targets.name: validator_thresholds
allowed_edit_targets.principle: threshold changes require held-out and negative-control deltas

allowed_edit_targets.name: kan_locality_anchors
allowed_edit_targets.principle: locality anchors may govern update locality without native KAN retraining

allowed_edit_targets.name: model_weights
allowed_edit_targets.principle: model-weight learning must be separated from controller-side learning

continuous_self_learning_scope: blocked controller-only governance aggregation; model weights remain out of scope.

field_principles.allowed_edit_targets: controller-side and model-weight learning must be separated
field_principles.forbidden_claims: capstone wording must not outrun evidence
field_principles.fr11_governance_ready: self-learning experiments must gate on explicit promotion rules
field_principles.inference_substrate: aggregation work must declare no live model inference

forbidden_claims: native model-weight learning or model-weight learning from Exp 3032/3033
live LLM inference, live model adaptation, or live model retraining
broad autonomous self-learning beyond controller-only cached replay
KAN retraining or KAN structural learning from an existing locality probe
unconditional FR-11 promotion without Exp 3046 metric and rollback gates

non_promotion_criteria.criterion: deny promotion if the scoring channel can grade its own update path
non_promotion_criteria.name: tautology

non_promotion_criteria.criterion: deny promotion if generated labels are accepted without independent checks
non_promotion_criteria.name: self_confirming_labels

non_promotion_criteria.criterion: deny promotion if train/update families overlap the held-out family
non_promotion_criteria.name: family_leakage

non_promotion_criteria.criterion: deny promotion if no-feedback and shuffled controls are absent
non_promotion_criteria.name: missing_negative_controls

prior_evidence_summary.limits: The prior evidence is controller-only cached replay. It supports a gated Exp 3046 protocol, but not native model-weight learning, broad continuous self-learning, or live inference claims.

required_metrics.measurement_rule: held-out family utility must improve after update
required_metrics.name: family_holdout_delta

required_metrics.measurement_rule: previous exact traces must not regress
required_metrics.name: prior_retention_delta

required_metrics.measurement_rule: replay without feedback must not improve
required_metrics.name: no_feedback_delta

required_metrics.measurement_rule: shuffled labels must not improve the controller
required_metrics.name: shuffled_control_delta

required_metrics.measurement_rule: graph size and contradiction rate must be logged
required_metrics.name: contradiction_graph_size_rate

required_metrics.measurement_rule: all automatic rollbacks must be counted
required_metrics.name: rollback_count

required_metrics.measurement_rule: delayed replay must expose late regressions
required_metrics.name: delayed_regression_delta

required_metrics.measurement_rule: every promoted update needs source-trace coverage
required_metrics.name: source_trace_completeness
